# setup

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(scales)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(ggforce)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggalluvial)
library(paletteer)
library(rstatix)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
	echo = TRUE,
	message = FALSE,
	warning = FALSE
)
options(scipen = 999)
```

-   Negative adapter combinations are labelled NC. These are:

    -   SP27_001_SP5_001

    -   SP27_001_SP5_009

    -   SP27_002_SP5_002

    -   SP27_002_SP5_010

    -   SP27_003_SP5_003

    -   SP27_003_SP5_011

    -   SP27_004_SP5_004

    -   SP27_004_SP5_012

    -   SP27_005_SP5_005

    -   SP27_006_SP5_006

    -   SP27_007_SP5_007

    -   SP27_008_SP5_007

    -   SP27_008_SP5_008

-   Two datasets are assessed here:

    -   `NTC_exp`: This has all amplicons + an annealing temp of 54°C

    -   `COI_47`: This has only COI amplicons + an annealing temp of 47°C

# Negative control read and contig counts

-   Only `NTC_exp`

## Reading in the data

-   this is basic seqkit stats for the read counts in demultiplexed bins, and also for the contigs assembled from the reads in each well

-   NB: I have *not* split between Moorea and Sauron for COI

```{r echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
reads_at_demux<-
  read_csv("review_address/negative_control_test/NTC_seqkit_stats.csv")

rRNAs<-
  read_csv("review_address/negative_control_test/NTC_seqkit_stats_rRNA.csv") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(gene = paste0(gene, "S"))

COIs<-
  read_csv("review_address/negative_control_test/NTC_seqkit_stats_COI.csv")


gene_nc_ids <- c(
  "SP27_001_SP5_001", "SP27_001_SP5_009",
  "SP27_002_SP5_002", "SP27_002_SP5_010",
  "SP27_003_SP5_003", "SP27_003_SP5_011",
  "SP27_004_SP5_004", "SP27_004_SP5_012",
  "SP27_005_SP5_005","SP27_006_SP5_006",
  "SP27_007_SP5_007","SP27_008_SP5_007", 
  "SP27_008_SP5_008"
)

barbell_whole_index <-
  read_tsv("review_address/negative_control_test/stats_M13_1mm_barbell_demux.tsv") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    type = ifelse(grepl(paste(gene_nc_ids, collapse = "|"), file), "NC", "Sample"),
    file = str_remove(file, "barbell/NTC_exp/demuxed/"),
    file = str_remove(file, "_NTC_exp.fastq.gz"),
    file = str_replace(file, "__", "_")
  )

barbell_rRNAs<-
  read_tsv("review_address/negative_control_test/stats_M13_1mm_barbell_rRNA.tsv") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    type = ifelse(grepl(paste(gene_nc_ids, collapse = "|"), file), "NC", "Sample"),
    gene = str_extract(file, "18S|28S"),
    file = gsub("rRNA_genes/NTC_exp/", "", file),
    file = str_remove(file, "_18S.fa | _28S.fa" )
  )

barbell_COIs<-
  read_tsv("review_address/negative_control_test/stats_M13_1mm_barbell_COI.tsv") %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(
    type = ifelse(grepl(paste(gene_nc_ids, collapse = "|"), file), "NC", "Sample"),
    file = gsub("COI_gene/NTC_exp/", "", file),
    file = str_remove(file, "_COI.fasta" )
  )
```

### Scatter plots (my favourite for this analysis)

-   The above are nice but it's easier to label outliers with a scatter/point plot.

-   With this I can more easily see which samples are problematic, and also calculate significance

-   I'm going with a Wilcox test (over an unpaired T-test) since I cannot assume normal distribution of the counts of contigs (or reads in the case of read demux)

-   I considered a Bonferroni correction for false positives (few tests done) but since the p-values for significant results is so low it would cause little effect. I'm also not (in this case) comparing between genes, but comparing between states (NC vs sample).

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
reads_at_demux %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(label= ifelse(type == "NC" & num_seqs > 10000, file, NA)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = type,
             y = num_seqs,
             color = type,
             label = label))+
  geom_point(size = 0.75)+
  scale_color_paletteer_d("nbapalettes::sixers_retro")+
  theme_minimal()+
  geom_text(size = 3, check_overlap = TRUE, nudge_y = 1.2, vjust = 0)+
  labs(title = "pychopper-cutadapt demux")+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,300000))+
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test",
                     label = "p.signif",
                     paired = FALSE,
                     comparisons = list(c("NC", "sample")),
                     label.y = 275000)

barbell_whole_index %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(label= ifelse(type == "NC" & num_seqs > 10000, file, NA)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = type, 
             y = num_seqs, 
             color = type,
             label = label))+
  geom_violin(trim = F)+
  geom_point(size = 0.75)+
  labs(title = "barbell demux + remove reads with M13 tags")+
  scale_color_paletteer_d("nbapalettes::sixers_retro")+
  theme_minimal()+
  geom_text(size = 3, check_overlap = TRUE, nudge_y = 1.2, vjust = 0)+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,300000))+
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", 
                     label = "p.signif", 
                     paired = FALSE,
                     comparisons = list(c("NC", "Sample")))

rRNAs %>%

  ggplot(aes(x = type,

barbell_rRNAs %>%

COIs%>%
```

### Some notes on Statistics

-   We noted that SP27_001_SP5_001 (well A1) is consistently causing issues in the pychopper-cutadapt approach, but we did not know why.

-   Here are the statistics just as data frames

```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
reads_at_demux %>%
  wilcox_test(num_seqs ~ type) %>%
  add_significance("p")

barbell_whole_index %>% 
  wilcox_test(num_seqs ~ type) %>% 
  add_significance("p")

rRNAs %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  wilcox_test(num_seqs ~ type) %>%
  add_significance("p")

barbell_rRNAs %>% 
  group_by(gene) %>% 
  wilcox_test(num_seqs ~ type) %>% 
  add_significance("p")

COIs %>%
  wilcox_test(num_seqs ~ type) %>%
  add_significance("p")

barbell_COIs %>% 
  wilcox_test(num_seqs ~ type) %>% 
  add_significance("p")
```

## Interim conclusion

-   There is a visual difference between NC and sample

-   The difference between NC and Sample is statistically significant too: completely when using barbell, and missing COI using pychopper-cutadapt, but for one sample.

    -   SP27_001_SP5_001 is an outlier

## From where do NC contigs source?

-   Specifically, we want to disentangle the source of SP27_001_SP5_001, but there are other contigs too we should follow up.

-   For this analysis, I made vsearch databases out of the sample contigs...\
    `vsearch --makeudb_usearch sample_wells_COI.fa --output COI_samples_vsearchdb`

-   ... and did a 97% identity `--usearch_global` search ...\
    `vsearch --usearch_global NC_wells_COI.fa --db COI_samples_vsearchdb --id 0.97 --top_hits_only --blast6out COI_vsearch_blast.tsv`

-   Below are the `blast outfmt 6` style results viewed

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
read_vsearch_blast <- function(path) {
  read_tsv(path, col_names = FALSE) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(qseqid = X1,
                sseqid = X2,
                pident = X3,
                length = X4,
                mismatch = X5,
                gapopen = X6,
                qstart = X7, 
                qend = X8,
                sstart= X9,
                send = X10,
                evalue = X11,
                bitscore = X12) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-gapopen, -mismatch, -evalue, -bitscore) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(NC = str_extract(qseqid, "SP27_[0-9]+_SP5_[0-9]+"),
                Sample = str_extract(sseqid, "SP27_[0-9]+_SP5_[0-9]+"),
                match_sample = ifelse(NC == Sample, T, F))
}

COI_vsearch <- read_vsearch_blast("review_address/negative_control_test/COI_vsearch_blast.tsv")

rRNA_vsearch <- read_vsearch_blast("review_address/negative_control_test/rRNA_vsearch_blast.tsv") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(gene = str_extract(qseqid, "18S|28S"))

barbell_COI_vsearch <- read_vsearch_blast("review_address/negative_control_test/COI_vsearch_barbell_M13_1mm_97.tsv")

barbell_rRNA_vsearch <- read_vsearch_blast("review_address/negative_control_test/rRNA_vsearch_barbell.tsv") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(gene = str_extract(qseqid, "18S|28S"))
```

## Tiling the sources of contamination

-   COIs

    -   in pychopper-cutadapt: As we know, there are 23 COI contigs in SP27_001_SP5_001, which is *supposed* to be NC

    -   These seem to come from all across the plate row-wise (SP5 indices), but column-wise it appears to be focused on SP27_001 (column 1)

-   rRNAs

    -   Negative control contigs only have matches in SP27_001 for the samples

```{r}
COI_vsearch %>%
  count(NC, Sample, match_sample) %>%
  mutate(n = factor(n)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(Sample, NC, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), size = 3, color = "white") +
  scale_fill_paletteer_d("MoMAColors::Althoff", name = "hits")+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid = element_blank())+
labs(title = "COIs (pychopper-cutadapt)")

barbell_COI_vsearch %>% 
  count(NC, Sample, match_sample) %>% 
  mutate(n = factor(n)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(Sample, NC, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), size = 3, color = "white") +
  scale_fill_paletteer_d("MoMAColors::Althoff", name = "hits")+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid = element_blank())+
labs(title = "COIs (barbell)")


rRNA_vsearch %>%
  count(NC, Sample, match_sample, gene) %>%
  mutate(n = factor(n)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(Sample, NC, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), size = 3, color = "white") +
  scale_fill_paletteer_d("MoMAColors::Althoff", name = "hits")+
  facet_wrap(~gene, ncol = 1)+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid = element_blank())+
labs(title = "rRNAs (pychopper-cutadapt)")

barbell_rRNA_vsearch %>%
  count(NC, Sample, match_sample, gene) %>%
  mutate(n = factor(n)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(Sample, NC, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), size = 3, color = "white") +
  scale_fill_paletteer_d("MoMAColors::Althoff", name = "hits")+
  facet_wrap(~gene, ncol = 1)+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid = element_blank())+
labs(title = "rRNAs (barbell)")

```

## A hypothesis about M13 tags

-   One hypothesis we have is that there's hopping due to a partial (or complete) indexing primer dimer at the M13 region, resulting in \>1 M13 sequence present in contigs

-   This explains why barbell does a better job than pychopper+cutadapt

-   We next searched for M13 sequences present in reads after initial barbell demultiplexing, to see if this was the case

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
read_tsv("review_address/negative_control_test/M13_in_demux_seqkit_locate_0mm.tsv") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(file = gsub("_NTC_exp.fastq.gz", "", file)) %>% 
  left_join(barbell_whole_index) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = motif, y = count, color = type))+
  geom_violin()+
  geom_jitter()+
  scale_color_paletteer_d("nbapalettes::sixers_retro")+
  facet_wrap(~type)+
  theme_minimal()+
  labs(title = "bfg exact counts")

read_tsv("review_address/negative_control_test/M13_in_demux_seqkit_locate_1mm.tsv") %>%
```

-   Does modulation of the permitted mismatches allow for an increase in read trashed?

```{r}
dir <- "review_address/negative_control_test"
files <- c(
  "exact" = "M13_in_barbell_demux.tsv",
  "1 mm"  = "M13_in_demux_seqkit_locate_1mm.tsv",
  "2 mm"  = "M13_in_demux_seqkit_locate_2mm.tsv",
  "3 mm"  = "M13_in_demux_seqkit_locate_3mm.tsv"
)

imap_dfr(files, ~ read_tsv(file.path(dir, .x), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
                  mutate(method = .y)) %>%
  mutate(file = gsub("_NTC_exp.fastq.gz", "", file),
         method = factor(method, levels = names(files))) %>%
  left_join(barbell_whole_index) %>%
  mutate(percentage = (count/num_seqs)*100) %>% 
  group_by(type, method, motif) %>%
  #group_by(method, motif) %>% 
  summarise(reads = sum(count), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = method, y = reads, stratum = motif, alluvium = motif, fill = motif)) +
  geom_flow(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_stratum(width = 0.3, colour = "grey30") +
  facet_wrap(~type) +
  scale_fill_paletteer_d("wesanderson::AsteroidCity3", name = "motif") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "mismatches allowed", y = "reads with motif (summed over wells)",
       title = "M13 motif matches by mismatch tolerance: counts")

imap_dfr(files, ~ read_tsv(file.path(dir, .x), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
                  mutate(method = .y)) %>%
  mutate(file = gsub("_NTC_exp.fastq.gz", "", file),
         method = factor(method, levels = names(files))) %>%
  left_join(barbell_whole_index) %>%          # see note on `by` below
  filter(num_seqs > 0) %>%
  group_by(type, method, motif) %>%
  summarise(
    pooled_pct = sum(count) / sum(num_seqs) * 100,
    mean_pct   = mean(count / num_seqs * 100),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = method, y = pooled_pct, stratum = motif, alluvium = motif, fill = motif)) +
  geom_flow(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_stratum(width = 0.3, colour = "grey30") +
  facet_wrap(~type) +
  scale_fill_paletteer_d("wesanderson::GrandBudapest1", name = "motif") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "mismatches allowed", y = "% of reads containing motif (pooled)",
       title = "M13 motif matches by mismatch tolerance: total percentages summed")

read_tsv("review_address/negative_control_test/SPs_in_demux_post_M13_removal.tsv") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(file = gsub("_NTC_exp.fastq.gz", "", file)) %>% 
  left_join(barbell_whole_index) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = motif, y = count, fill = type))+
  #geom_violin()+
  geom_point()+
  scale_fill_paletteer_d("nbapalettes::sixers_retro")+
  facet_wrap(~type)+
  theme_minimal()+
  labs(title = "SP tags remaining in demuxed reads after M13-containing reads are trashed")
```

-   It appears that after 1 mismatch, increase is negligible

-   Additionally, a high percentage of reasds in NC have M13 extra tags, so these can be removed which safely cleans up hopped reads

-   Is there a possible common segment in the M13 motif that's variable more than most other positions?

```{r}
library(ggseqlogo)

hits <- read_tsv("review_address/negative_control_test/M13_1mm_motif_hits.tsv", col_names = F) %>%
  dplyr::rename(file = X1,
                motif = X2,
                read_id = X3,
                strand = X4,
                start = X5,
                end = X6, 
                matched = X7) %>% 
  mutate(file = gsub("_NTC_exp.fastq.gz", "", file)) %>%
  left_join(barbell_whole_index)

# one logo per motif
ggseqlogo(split(hits$matched, hits$motif), seq_type = "dna")

# NC vs Sample, per motif
ggseqlogo(split(hits$matched, paste(hits$type, hits$motif)), seq_type = "dna")

hits %>%
  filter(motif == "M13F") %>%
  separate_wider_position(matched, setNames(rep(1, 17), paste0("p", 1:17))) %>%
  pivot_longer(starts_with("p"), names_to = "pos", values_to = "base") %>%
  count(pos, base) %>%
  group_by(pos) %>% mutate(freq = n / sum(n))

```

# Examining differences in COI contigs at different annealing temperatures

-   For this analysis, I've once again made vsearch databases for COI contigs in the `NTC_exp` dataset and the `COI_47` dataset, and reciprocally searched (with `vsearch --usearch_global`) COI amplicons against the opposite databases

-   I have made both stacked bar plot and venn diagram

-   The numbers are hardcoded in from:

```{$ grep -c ">" *fa}
COI47_in_COI54.fa:258
COI47_not_in_COI54.fa:158
COI47_samples.fa:416
COI54_in_COI47.fa:233
COI54_not_in_COI47.fa:72
COI54_samples.fa:305
```

```{r}
# counts (sample wells only)
n_coi47 <- 416
n_coi54 <- 305

hit_coi47 <- 258   # COI_47 contigs with a >=97% hit in COI_54
hit_coi54 <- 233   # COI_54 contigs with a >=97% hit in COI_47

miss_coi47 <- n_coi47 - hit_coi47
miss_coi54 <- n_coi54 - hit_coi54 

# bar plot
data.frame(
  direction = rep(c("COI_47 queried vs COI_54", "COI_54 queried vs COI_47"), each = 2),
  status    = rep(c("≥97% hit", "no hit"), times = 2),
  n         = c(hit_coi47, miss_coi47, hit_coi54, miss_coi54)) %>%
  group_by(direction) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(direction, n, fill = status)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5)) +
  geom_text(aes(y = 1, label = paste0("n = ", total)), vjust = -0.5, check_overlap = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_paletteer_d("nbapalettes::pacers_classic") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Contigs in query set", fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()

# venn: regions are contigs by match status
shared <- hit_coi47 + hit_coi54

area_coi47 <- miss_coi47 + shared   # area of COI_47 circle
area_coi54 <- miss_coi54 + shared   # area of COI_54 circle

r_coi47 <- 1
r_coi54 <- sqrt(area_coi54 / area_coi47)

# lens (intersection) area of two circles at centre distance d
lens_area <- function(d, r1, r2) {
  r1^2 * acos((d^2 + r1^2 - r2^2) / (2 * d * r1)) +
    r2^2 * acos((d^2 + r2^2 - r1^2) / (2 * d * r2)) -
    0.5 * sqrt((-d + r1 + r2) * (d + r1 - r2) * (d - r1 + r2) * (d + r1 + r2))
}

d <- uniroot(function(d) lens_area(d, r_coi47, r_coi54) - pi * r_coi47^2 * shared / area_coi47,
             lower = abs(r_coi47 - r_coi54) + 1e-6,
             upper = r_coi47 + r_coi54 - 1e-6)$root

circles <- data.frame(
  set = c("COI_47", "COI_54"),
  x   = c(0, d),
  y   = 0,
  r   = c(r_coi47, r_coi54)
)

overlap_lo <- d - r_coi54

# "only" labels: anchor inside the crescent, text outside
labs_df <- data.frame(
  label = c(paste0(miss_coi47, "\nCOI_47 only"), paste0(miss_coi54, "\nCOI_54 only")),
  xs    = c((-r_coi47 + overlap_lo) / 2, (r_coi47 + d + r_coi54) / 2),
  x     = c(-r_coi47 - 0.3, d + r_coi54 + 0.3),
  hjust = c(1, 0)
)

ggplot() +
  geom_circle(data = circles,
              aes(x0 = x, y0 = y, r = r, fill = set, colour = set),
              alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_segment(data = labs_df, aes(x = xs, xend = x, y = 0, yend = 0), colour = "grey30") +
  geom_point(data = labs_df, aes(x = xs, y = 0), size = 1, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_text(data = labs_df, aes(x = x, y = 0, label = label, hjust = hjust),
            size = 4, nudge_x = c(-0.03, 0.03)) +
  annotate("text", x = (overlap_lo + r_coi47) / 2, y = 0,
           label = paste0(shared, "\nshared"), size = 4) +
  annotate("text", x = c(-0.5, 0.7), y = r_coi47 + 0.15,
           label = c("COI_47", "COI_54"), fontface = "bold") +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(-2.2, 2.2)) +
  scale_fill_paletteer_d("nbapalettes::pacers_classic") +
  scale_color_paletteer_d("nbapalettes::pacers_classic") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## Interim conclusion

-   Lower annealing temp = moar contigs

-   The majority of contigs are shared
